scope: Area-selected real pipes, reversible full-green absorption, hypothetical storm/drainage loss, six runoff/depth maps and source-backed river context
source_values: Original DTM and P/C/S unchanged; new separate scenario derivatives

green_absorption.policy: Cell centres inside the union of every mapped nonempty green polygon are scenario-excluded. Holes are retained; overlaps count once. Display subset and visibility have no effect.
green_absorption.scenario_assumption: At the user’s request, all mapped green areas are assumed to absorb water and therefore are excluded from displayed risk. This is a reversible scenario assumption, not measured infiltration or a hydraulic result.
limitations: Mapped green areas do not establish soil permeability, infiltration rate, antecedent saturation or storage capacity.
This scenario assumes complete absorption; intense rainfall may exceed real infiltration or storage.
5 m cell-centre membership may omit narrow slivers; native source geometry and original terrain scores remain unchanged.
The mask covers the analysis rectangle; outside terrain, water and uncertainty retain their independent policies.
green_absorption.interpretation: User-defined full absorption scenario; mapped green areas are excluded from the displayed risk, without changing original terrain scores.

river_context.filter: Only exact water=river or legacy waterway=riverbank polygons, plus official geometry_role=assessment_reach LineString/MultiLineString. No schematic points, lake/reservoir/pond distance or invented river buffers enter nearest distances.
river_context.interpretation: Proximity to mapped river geometry is contextual evidence only. River-adjacent land may have mixed rainfall, river or drainage influences; distance does not determine flood cause. Away from mapped rivers does not establish pluvial causation or absence of an unmapped river.
limitations: Source snapshots and designated reaches are incomplete river mapping; narrow, intermittent, covered or unmapped channels may be missing.
The threshold is an adjustable proximity screening choice, not a floodplain boundary, return period or hydraulic connection.
Distances to river polygons measure distance to their actual footprint; points inside have distance zero. Distances to reaches use their supplied line geometry.
Reported flood mechanisms are preserved. This context never relabels an observed event as fluvial or pluvial.
Official reaches are prospective designations, not observed flood extents. Source dates are retained under the requested time-compatible scenario.

model_limits: Proximity is context, never a confirmed flood cause. Original reported mechanisms remain unchanged.
Estimated depth uses capped local depression storage; no surface routing, connected pipe hydraulics, river exchange or calibrated flood forecast.
Drainage capacity and influence buffer are editable assumptions. Mapped greens fully absorb rainfall only by the user scenario assumption.
Overflow, nondepression unallocated water, boundary truncation and numerical residual remain explicit.

performance.scope: 400m by400m EPSG7801 AOI centred23.267111,42.684845; genuine local sources, fresh derivative cache; one cold and three distinct-rain warm full calculations
performance.note: Single local measurement, not a citywide benchmark. Warm recalculations use new rainfall parameters and recompute actual runoff/storage; only the unchanged geometry/eligibility/proximity distance grid is reused.

checks: Actual rectangle drag selects existing source pipe; selected blue pipe, blue AOI and grey filled buildings render together.
Rain slider and numeric field stay synchronized and automatically recalculate after pause.
Depth legends in metres and runoff legends in millimetres remain separate; scenario hides original P while visible; hiding restores P.
River filter changes shown cells only; full-selection totals and download semantics labelled.
Rainfall archival overlay remains supplemental and off; all original tabs retained.
Cold startup waits for revision metadata; actual fresh final-bundle browser emitted no errors.
